profile.positioning: A highly analytical and results-oriented Group Product Manager at Synapse Solutions, I lead the product strategy and execution for our AI-powered marketing analytics platform. Synapse empowers marketing teams to optimize campaigns, personalize customer experiences, and drive measurable ROI through predictive insights. I’m currently leading the integration of generative AI capabilities – specifically large language models – to automate content creation, enhance campaign analysis, and unlock new personalization opportunities. Prior to Synapse, I spent time as an embedded consultant at Stellar Advertising, gaining invaluable firsthand experience with the challenges marketers face daily. This experience informs my product decisions and ensures we’re building solutions that truly resonate with our user base. I’m passionate about leveraging AI to empower marketers and drive sustainable growth, and I’m always eager to connect with others who share this vision. My core focus is on building scalable, data-driven products that deliver demonstrable value to our customers.
